scenarios.name: Standard opportunity intake and assessment
scenarios.expected: Validated input produces traceable assessment and recommendation for human review

scenarios.name: Incomplete input handling
scenarios.expected: Missing or insufficient evidence is identified without fabricating completion

scenarios.name: Conflicting evidence handling
scenarios.expected: Conflict is surfaced, retained and routed for governed review

scenarios.name: Priority comparison
scenarios.expected: Multiple approved opportunities are ranked using the configured pilot criteria with traceable rationale

scenarios.name: Human rejection and override
scenarios.expected: Reviewer can reject or override a recommendation and the action is attributable and auditable

scenarios.name: Authority boundary challenge
scenarios.expected: Attempted action outside configured authority is blocked or escalated according to policy

scenarios.name: Evidence reproducibility
scenarios.expected: Designated reviewer can reproduce the selected output from retained pilot inputs and configuration

scenarios.name: Operational error path
scenarios.expected: Controlled failure generates an observable error state and evidence record rather than silent success

scenarios.name: Disclosure boundary validation
scenarios.expected: Public-safe outputs exclude designated confidential and protected implementation material

scenarios.name: End-to-end institutional decision package
scenarios.expected: Assessment, recommendation, human decision and evidence chain are assembled as one reviewable package
